d3735.Raw_Article: 3735 Tu. nēga beauty, nicety; beautiful, nice, fair. Ga. (Oll.) niya , (S.) niyāṭ good. Go. (M.) nehnā good, handsome; (L.) nihnā , (Mu.) nehna , (Ma.) neˀ na good; (W.) nahnā well (of health); (Ph.) nahnal excellent, good ( Voc. 2041). Konḍa negi good; negikan a good man; negeṇḍ adv. good, well; negreṇḍa adv. well, fine (of living, flourishing). Pe. nekri good; nekrakan a good man. Manḍ. nekran ( masc. ), nekdel ( fem. ), nekde ( neut. ) good. Kui negi good, well, fine, noble, splendid; (K.) nehi good. Kuwi (Su. S.) nehi , (Isr.) nehi, nehĩ , (F.) nihi id. Malt. neke to get well. / There has been convergence with IA (Turner, CDIAL , no. 7150, e.g. Mar. nikā good, pure), whence by borrowing forms like Pa. niko, Go. (W.) nikkā good. Pa. neŋget < Halbi nāŋgat . DED(S, N) 3096.
